plugins.name: thinking-tools
plugins.description: Claude Code thinking skills plugin: expert panel discussions, document concretization, document polish, diverse sampling, blind spot detection, thought chain orchestration, adversarial claim review, and thinking facilitator agent.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault-manager
plugins.description: Obsidian vault knowledge management plugin: agents and skills for note creation, MOC management, project tracking, inbox review (4-phase pipeline with ≥3x token reduction), project archiving, note↔project bidirectional binding, Obsidian-native formatting guidance, optional Defuddle URL extraction for captures, optional Obsidian CLI acceleration, and vault-audit (9-error-type structural integrity scan with ≥93% detection / <10% FP against fixture), plus reusable shell primitives (ovm-primitives.sh) for frontmatter scanning, wikilink extraction, and audit-state tracking.

plugins.name: vault-bridge
plugins.description: Obsidian vault ↔ external project bridge plugin with vault manifest caching, optional Obsidian CLI search acceleration, direct-access awareness, session auto-commit, write path governance, opt-in plan-doc autosync, and session handoff. Agent (vault-searcher, haiku) + Stop/SessionEnd/SessionStart/PreToolUse hooks + /save-session + /handoff + /vault-manifest-refresh + /vault-commit + /save-plan-doc commands + .vault-link pointer-based project binding. vault-searcher acts as read/search agent only (read-only since v1.9.0). Vault writes are restricted to slash commands executed in main context; subagent vault writes are policy-blocked via VAULT_BRIDGE_WRITE_CONTRACT. Searches notes, loads domain context, restores session context, enforces file naming conventions, commits vault changes with user approval, and snapshots external plan/design docs into the bound vault project behind a 2-layer opt-in gate.
